crossRefs.note: Ahaziah was forty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was…
Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal offspring.

parallels.note: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal offspring.

people.name: Ahaziah
people.line: King of Judah, son of Jehoram and Athaliah

people.name: Athaliah
people.line: Queen of Judah, daughter of Ahab and Jezebel

translations.web: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal offspring of the house of Judah.
translations.bsb: When Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she proceeded to annihilate all the royal heirs of the house of Judah.
translations.kjv: But when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Judah.
translations.asv: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Judah.
